mapper.sql: models.provider_code, models.model_key, models.display_name, models.context_window, models.capabilities::text AS capabilities_json, models.capability_source, models.verified_at, models.enabled, providers.enabled AS provider_enabled
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM models JOIN providers ON providers.code = models.provider_code WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY models.provider_code, models.model_key LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT providers.code, providers.display_name, providers.protocol, providers.default_base_url, providers.enabled, (SELECT count(*) FROM models WHERE models.provider_code = providers.code) AS model_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM models WHERE models.provider_code = providers.code AND models.enabled = TRUE) AS enabled_model_count FROM providers ORDER BY providers.code

SELECT providers.code, providers.display_name, providers.protocol, providers.default_base_url, providers.enabled, (SELECT count(*) FROM models WHERE models.provider_code = providers.code) AS model_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM models WHERE models.provider_code = providers.code AND models.enabled = TRUE) AS enabled_model_count FROM providers WHERE providers.code = #{code}
